name: Swimming pool maintenance
summary: How landed-home and some strata owners arrange swimming pool maintenance in Singapore — chemical balancing, pump servicing, and haze/algae realities after storms.
body:
Private pool upkeep is chemistry plus mechanicals: chlorine/pH, filters, pumps, and tile cleaning. Weekly contractor visits are common for landed homes; condo pools are usually MCST-managed — this guide targets owners who actually pay a pool vendor.

## Scope to define
- Water testing and dosing schedules
- Filter backwash and pump health
- Tile brushing and skimmer baskets
- Leak suspicion escalation
- Holiday cover / robot cleaner options

After heavy rain or haze, green water appears fast — response SLAs matter.

## Contracts
Clarify visit frequency, chemical inclusions, and emergency call-out fees. Ask who buys acid/chlorine and how empty-house access works. Get written notes when equipment replacement is recommended — pumps are expensive surprises.

## How to choose
Prefer vendors who log readings, not only “looks blue.” Check references for similar pool sizes. Avoid anonymous Telegram-only dosing without safety sheets for pets/kids.

## Practical tip
Keep a spare test kit to spot-check between visits. Lock chemical stores away from helpers’ kids and pets.
